names.note: The nominative the day page's own `/name/9424.html` link carries in its `title`, «Александр (Ерошов), иерей, сщмч.», with the two trailing rank words left off; the surname in parentheses is part of the name and stays. The day's line gives only the bare forename in the genitive, and prints it **twice** — this is the first of the two Alexanders of the company, whose name link is 9424 against the other's 9448. `fk.mjs` on this form returned NONE before the write.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 19 мая ст. ст., which is the year for all fourteen people that line names. His name page gives no year at all and no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Антония , еп. Белгородского, и с ним Митрофана , Александра , Михаила , Ипполита , Николая , Василия , Николая , Максима , Александра , Павла , Павла , Георгия пресвитеров и мч. Михаила (1938).»

attestations.note: Second of the thirteen named «и с ним» after the bishop of Belgorod. **The line prints «Александра» twice and the two are two men**, told apart only by the name links behind them: 9424, «Александр (Ерошов)», which is this folder, and 9448, «Александр (Саульский)», written in the next batch of this day. The same holds for the two Nicholases (9710, 9731) and the two Pauls (9744, 9748) of the same line — six people behind three repeated forenames, and the name links are the whole of what distinguishes them. **The line and the name link are all there is**: 9424 is a heading, the grade and two days, with no narrative. azbyka.ru was not read.
